description: Change the recipient or lines of an order that was never paid (no payment tried). It is quoted again: offer has the new quoteId and total, nextStep how to pay. The lines given replace all the lines.

RetailLineTotal.description: Optional. What your customer paid for this line in total (quantity × your price, after discounts, before tax and shipping): integer cents (amount × 100) and an upper-case ISO 4217 currency. Informational only: it counts toward your revenue figure and never changes the quote, the charge or what is printed. It is not part of the replay body, so a replay that differs only here returns the existing order.

retailLineTotal.description: Optional: what your customer paid for this line, for your revenue figure only

title.description: Line title, e.g. the design name

country.description: US (the only country we ship to)
